status_vocabulary.formal_status: compiler_indexed means the exact declaration and its captured premise rows came from a pinned Lean elaboration; it does not certify explanation quality.
status_vocabulary.interpretation_status: authored_pending_review means the short prose is an index overlay awaiting human mathematical review.
status_vocabulary.evidence_status: compiler_edge means the relation is backed by a captured USES_IN_TYPE or USES_IN_PROOF row; authored_hierarchy is an overlay relation only.

components.title: Finite-observer CSH interface
components.summary: Packages the CSHHolds proposition for a finite vertex type, strict edge weights, an owner and avoided set, decoys, and distinct observer points.
assumptions: x ∉ Y, o ∉ insert x Y, v ∉ insert x Y, o ≠ v
D.Nodup and every decoy avoids the owner, avoided set, and observers
outputs: Percolation.Continuity.CSH.CSHHolds w x Y D o v
limits: Strictness and distinctness are assumptions of this interface and its constructors; they are not silently inferred from the CSHHolds result.

components.title: Uniform finite-observer CSH constructor
components.summary: Turns strict finite edge weights and the quantified distinctness/avoidance data into the uniform CSHHolds proposition required by the continuity bridge.
assumptions: ∀ e : Sym2 (Fin n), 0 < w e ∧ w e < 1
o ≠ v, x ∉ Y, o ≠ x, v ≠ x, o ∉ Y, v ∉ Y
D.Nodup and every d ∈ D avoids x, Y, o, and v
outputs: ∀ n w and admissible finite data, CSHHolds w x (↑Y) D o v
limits: The index records the theorem's exact binders and proof uses; it does not restate the internal combinatorial proof in prose.

components.title: CSH to additive gluing
components.summary: Consumes a uniform CSH hypothesis and returns the formal AdditiveGluing proposition.
assumptions: A uniform hCSH with the exact finite-size, strict-weight, distinctness, and decoy hypotheses in the declaration type.
limits: The statement's AdditiveGluing output is not identified here with a stronger multiplicative or near-one statement.

components.title: CSH to all-dimensional continuity
components.summary: The CSH bridge takes a uniform hCSH and dimension d ≥ 2 and returns the formal PercolationContinuity proposition.
assumptions: hCSH has the exact universal finite graph interface; d : ℕ and 2 ≤ d.
limits: The indexed theorem result is a proposition; this component does not claim that the source prose supplies an independently reviewed mathematical explanation.

components.title: Additive gluing to continuity bridge
components.summary: Consumes the formal AdditiveGluing proposition and returns PercolationContinuity; its captured proof also uses the near-one bridge.
limits: The component name describes the declaration interface, while the proof-use edge to near-one is retained separately and is not flattened into a narrative step.

components.title: Near-one gluing and Conjecture 3 bridge
components.summary: Records the exact Iff between the formal NearOneGluing statement and the literature Conjecture 3 proposition.
limits: The source declaration is Iff.rfl/definitionally aligned; that is not independent evidence that a literature statement corresponds to the formalization.

components.title: Near-one gluing to continuity
components.summary: Consumes NearOneGluing and d ≥ 2 and returns PercolationContinuity; the captured proof explicitly uses the Kozma–Nitzan theorem-6 endpoint.
limits: The index does not infer a full literature-to-formal correspondence from the name or citation alone.

components.title: CSH proof of formal Conjecture 3
components.summary: The formal theorem concludes the exact KozmaNitzan2024_conjecture3 proposition and its captured proof uses cshAll and conjecture3_of_csh.
limits: A theorem in the Lean source is not by itself a human-reviewed account of the intended published theorem.

components.title: Kozma–Nitzan theorem-6 endpoint
components.summary: Indexes the formal theorem-6 proposition and the of-slabCritical route that supplies it under its exact hypotheses.
assumptions: The of-slabCritical declaration takes hslab and θ_slab_criticalProb_zd_eq_zero.
limits: The formal endpoint is not a claim that every source-level theorem-6 interpretation has been independently checked.

components.title: All-dimensional continuity endpoint
components.summary: The formal allDimensions theorem concludes PercolationContinuity d for d ≥ 2 and is the direct upstream endpoint used by the Solution surface theorem.
limits: This is the exact formal endpoint; component prose does not assert that the theorem is mathematically useful without human review.

components.title: Solution public theorem surface
components.summary: The separately elaborated Solution surface exports the BondPercolation continuity theorem and its d = 3 corollary.
assumptions: d : ℕ; 2 ≤ d for the general theorem.
limits: The Solution and Challenge surfaces are indexed separately because their public names collide in Lean.

components.title: Challenge public theorem surface
components.summary: The separately elaborated Challenge surface preserves the upstream exercise statements and is not conflated with the proved Solution surface.
assumptions: d : ℕ; 2 ≤ d for the general theorem.
limits: The fresh Challenge build emitted two sorry warnings; the capture manifest records sorryAx occurrences. This component is not evidence that the Challenge declarations prove the Solution theorem.
